status: Prototype 014 implementation; owner checkpoint testing proceeds independently of continued desktop validation

messages.ViridianForestYoungster1Text: I came here with some friends!They're out for POKEMON fights!
messages.ViridianForestYoungster2BattleText: Hey! You have POKEMON! Come on! Let's battle 'em!
messages.ViridianForestYoungster2AfterBattleText: Ssh! You'll scare the bugs away!
messages.ViridianForestYoungster3BattleText: Yo! You can't jam out if you're a POKEMON trainer!
messages.ViridianForestYoungster3EndBattleText: Huh? I ran out of POKEMON!
messages.ViridianForestYoungster3AfterBattleText: Darn! I'm going to catch some stronger ones!
messages.ViridianForestYoungster4BattleText: Hey, wait up! What's the hurry?
messages.ViridianForestYoungster4EndBattleText: I give! You're good at this!
messages.ViridianForestYoungster4AfterBattleText: Sometimes, you can find stuff on the ground!I'm looking for the stuff I dropped!
messages.ViridianForestCooltrainerFBattleText: Hi, do you have a PIKACHU?
messages.ViridianForestCooltrainerFAfterBattleTex: I looked forever, but I never found a PIKACHU here!
messages.ViridianForestYoungster5BattleText: I'm gonna be the best. You just can't beat me!
messages.ViridianForestYoungster5AfterBattleText: A METAPOD is cool because its attack is its defense!
messages.ViridianForestYoungster6Text: I ran out of POKE BALLs to catch POKEMON with!You should carry extras!
messages.ViridianForestTrainerTips1Text: TRAINER TIPSIf you want to avoid battles, stay away from grassy areas!
messages.ViridianForestUseAntidoteSignText: For poison, use ANTIDOTE! Get it at POKEMON MARTs!
messages.ViridianForestTrainerTips2Text: TRAINER TIPSContact PROF.OAK via PC to get your POKEDEX evaluated!
messages.ViridianForestTrainerTips3Text: TRAINER TIPSNo stealing of POKEMON from other trainers! Catch only wild POKEMON!
messages.ViridianForestTrainerTips4Text: TRAINER TIPSWeaken POKEMON before attempting capture!When healthy, they may escape!
messages.ViridianForestLeavingSignText: LEAVING VIRIDIAN FOREST PEWTER CITY AHEAD
messages.ViridianForestSouthGateGirlText: Are you going to VIRIDIAN FOREST? Be careful, it's a natural maze!
messages.ViridianForestSouthGateLittleGirlText: You have to roam far to get new kinds of POKEMON.Look for other types outside of VIRIDIAN FOREST.
messages.ViridianForestNorthGateSuperNerdText: Many POKEMON live only in forests  and caves.You need to look everywhere to get different kinds!
messages.ViridianForestNorthGateGrampsText: Have you noticed the bushes on the roadside?They can be cut down by a special POKEMON move.
